decision.question: Abura positioning: Affordable luxury or True luxury? This is blocking the wholesale catalog.
decision.recommendation: Pick affordable luxury. Otto's background and Abura's current market position don't support true luxury pricing. Ship the catalog this week.
evidence: VDR questions flagged this as a high-severity gap on March 22
Wholesale email sequence exists but can't be sent without pricing clarity
Every week of delay = missed wholesale season opportunities

options.label: Affordable luxury
options.description: Premium positioning at accessible price points. Ship catalog this week.

options.label: True luxury
options.description: High-end positioning. Requires brand investment Otto may not have bandwidth for.

options.label: Kill Abura focus
options.description: It's commission-based. Deprioritize entirely and focus on IAM/Oopuo.
